about: Check-ins tab (the athlete, Nov 1, 2026): the surveys that feed Health Pillars, by cadence. Definitions only. Answers are saved by the page to the dashboard store as checkin/<survey>-<period> documents {survey, period, answers: {qid: value}, saved_at}; the morning run ingests them with coach/tools/checkins.py into coach/checkins.csv (and health.json for nicotine, the physical, BP, labs and self-tests). Periods: weekly = the Monday's date, monthly YYYY-MM, quarterly YYYY-Qn, half YYYY-H1/H2 until Nov 10, 2026, then YYYY-MM of the due date (the home BP week follows a cadence: coach/tools/bp_cadence.py), yearly YYYY. Every question is optional; a skipped answer is unknown, never zero. Daily and after-session check-ins are the existing feel_daily and feel_sessions forms.
setup_about: The kit's 'Your first two weeks' check-in (goal-first onboarding). kit/build_kit.py adds this survey and its questions to the kit's coach/checkins.json; the original athlete's own file never holds them. A question with a `module` is shown only when coach/athlete/profile.json goals.modules names it (setup/personalize.py decides the modules from the goals picked at onboarding; coach/tools/build_dashboard.py does the filtering). Questions without a module go to everyone. Every question is optional. Answers are read by coach/tools/setup_answers.py. Question types are the Check-in tab's own: choice, checklist, number.

surveys.name: Your first two weeks
surveys.when: Any time, about 2 min, a few taps at a time

surveys.name: Quarterly
surveys.when: Once a quarter, about 10 min with the tests

surveys.name: Yearly
surveys.when: Once a year, about 5 min plus your physical

questions.q: What do you enjoy most?
questions.hint: Tick any. The coach builds your weeks around these.

questions.q: Anything you would rather avoid?
questions.hint: Tick any, or none.

questions.q: How do you like to be coached?
What can you use?
questions.hint: Tick any. The coach only plans what you have.

questions.q: What year were you born?
questions.hint: Sets your starting heart rate zones and the age group you are compared with. Skip if you would rather not say.

questions.q: Which reference ranges should the coach use?
questions.hint: Fitness norms differ by sex. Skip if you would rather not say.

questions.q: Your max heart rate, if you know it
questions.hint: Only from a hard race or an all-out test. Skip if you are not sure; the coach starts from an estimate and corrects it.

questions.q: When is your first meal on a normal day?
questions.hint: The coach works around how you eat. It only speaks up on mornings when a big session needs food first.

questions.q: How settled is that habit?
Have you practised eating and drinking during sessions over 90 minutes?
opts: I do not go that long yet

questions.q: Which change matters most to you?
questions.hint: The coach keeps any change gradual and training first. You set the target together in chat, never here.

questions.q: How often would you like to weigh in?
How much lifting have you done?
How many strength sessions a week would you like?
What are you coming back from?
Is a clinician or physio guiding your return?
questions.hint: If yes, the coach plans inside what they allow.

questions.q: On a bad week, what would you still do?
questions.hint: This becomes your minimum week. Doing it counts as a win.

questions.q: What usually gets in the way?
questions.hint: Tick any.

questions.q: How many alcoholic drinks did you have this week?
questions.hint: One drink = 12 oz beer, 5 oz wine or 1.5 oz spirits.
questions.adaptive: moves to monthly after 8 weeks of 0; back to weekly after any 8+

questions.q: Strength or mobility sessions the watch didn't record?
questions.hint: Only ones not on the watch or the Lifts log.

questions.q: Sauna sessions the watch didn't record?
How much did you enjoy training this week?
Waist at the navel
questions.hint: On waking, after breathing out, tape level and snug. Inches.

questions.q: Over the last 2 weeks…
questions.hint: WHO-5 wellbeing index.
items: I have felt cheerful and in good spirits
I have felt calm and relaxed
I have felt active and vigorous
I woke up feeling fresh and rested
My daily life has been filled with things that interest me

questions.q: Scale extras (if your scale shows them)
questions.hint: From the scale app's detail screen. Skip if you don't have them.

questions.q: How useful was the coach this month?
questions.hint: The coach is judged by what you got from it.

questions.q: What helped most?
questions.hint: Tick any.

questions.q: What got in the way?
questions.hint: Tick any. Anything else, tell the coach in chat.
items: Plans that did not fit my day

questions.q: Self-tests
questions.hint: Sit-to-rise: from standing, sit cross-legged on the floor and stand up; start at 10, minus 1 per hand, knee or forearm support, minus 0.5 per wobble; best of two. One-leg stand: barefoot, hands on hips, eyes open, up to 30 s; record the weaker leg. Grip: only with a hand dynamometer, best of 3, stronger hand.

questions.q: Tick each one that's true for you most weeks
questions.hint: Mediterranean diet checklist (PREDIMED MEDAS, without its wine item).
items: Olive oil is my main cooking fat
4+ tablespoons of olive oil a day (cooking, salads, bread)
Under 1 serving of red or processed meat a day
Under 1 serving of butter, margarine or cream a day
Under 1 sugary or sweetened drink a day
3+ servings of beans, lentils or chickpeas a week
3+ servings of fish or seafood a week
Under 3 store-bought sweets or pastries a week
Chicken or turkey more often than red meat
2+ times a week, a tomato, onion and garlic sauce with olive oil

questions.q: How often do you feel…
questions.hint: Three-item loneliness scale (Hughes 2004).

questions.q: Home blood pressure, 7-day average
questions.hint: Seated 5 min, arm at heart level, 2 readings morning and evening for 7 days; drop day 1 and average the rest.

questions.q: Do you use nicotine (smoking, vaping, pouches)?
When was your last physical with bloodwork?
Date of that physical (if you know it)
Your results from it
questions.hint: Copy from your lab report; leave out anything you don't have.

questions.q: Skin check by a clinician this year?
Age-based screenings up to date (for example colon cancer from 45)?
Any new heart disease, diabetes or cancer in close family?
Any new diagnosis or regular medicine since last year?
questions.hint: If yes, tell the coach in chat; it changes training rules.
